verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists, and it advertises a free tier with "No charges ever" [grafana-docs-13]. A community user also describes Grafana Cloud as far cheaper than competitors [grafana-comm-7]. That implies self-serve, published pricing, but nothing in the pack shows actual per-signal rates (metrics, logs, traces) or a way to forecast spend without sales. Missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices for metrics, logs and traces, usage-based cost estimation or calculator, evidence that paid tiers need no sales contact, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
